\n\n-- Azeroth Survivors: the run for addons, off the server's addon lines. See the README's\n-- "For addon authors" for every field.\nAZS_ZONE = {};\nAZS_RUN = {};\nAZS_SCHEDULE = {};\nAZS_UNITS = {};\nAZS_DEBUFFS = {};\nAZS_TARGET = { kind = "none" };\nAZS_SPELLS = {};\nAZS_TIMERS = {};\nAZS_BUFFS = {};\nAZS_PETS = {};\nAZS_METER = {};\nAZS_HEALING = {};\nAZS_BOSSMETER = {};\nAZS_PARTY = {};\nAZS_REVIVE = {};\nAZS_CHESTS = {};\nAZS_LAIRS = {};\nAZS_TAKEN = {};\nAZS_END = {};\nAZS_BANNERS = {};\nAZS_BANNER_HANDLERS = {};\n\n-- The run's own key binding (Bindings.xml, `bindings.rs`).\nBINDING_HEADER_AZS = "Azeroth Survivors";\nBINDING_NAME_AZS_OPENLEVELS = "Open Level-Ups";\n\nfunction AZS_Fields(msg)\n
local t = {};\n
local pos = 1;\n
while ( true ) do\n
local s, e, k, v = string.find(msg, "(%w+)=([^;]*)", pos);\n
if ( not s ) then\n
break;\n
end\n
t[k] = tonumber(v) or v;\n
pos = e + 1;\n
end\n
return t;\nend\n\n-- A list line: entries split by ";", fields by ",", named by `names`.\nfunction AZS_List(msg, names)\n
local list = {};\n
local pos = 1;\n
local len = string.len(msg);\n
while ( pos <= len ) do\n
local s, e = string.find(msg, ";", pos, 1);\n
local entry = string.sub(msg, pos, (s or len + 1) - 1);\n
local row = {};\n
local i = 1;\n
local fpos = 1;\n
while ( names[i] ) do\n
local fs = string.find(entry, ",", fpos, 1);\n
local v = string.sub(entry, fpos, (fs or string.len(entry) + 1) - 1);\n
row[names[i]] = tonumber(v) or v;\n
if ( not fs ) then\n
break;\n
end\n
fpos = fs + 1;\n
end\n
table.insert(list, row);\n
if ( not s ) then\n
break;\n
end\n
pos = e + 1;\n
end\n
return list;\nend\n\n-- The run's clock in seconds, carried on between the server's lines while it runs.\nfunction AZS_GetRunTime()\n
local t = AZS_RUN.t;\n
if ( not t ) then\n
return nil;\n
end\n
if ( AZS_RUN.ph == "playing" and AZS_RUN_UPDATED ) then\n
t = t + (GetTime() - AZS_RUN_UPDATED);\n
end\n
return t;\nend\n\n-- ready, playing, choosing, paused, dead or victory; nil out of a run.\nfunction AZS_GetPhase()\n
return AZS_RUN.ph;\nend\n\n-- When the final boss comes, in run seconds.\nfunction AZS_GetRunLength()\n
return AZS_ZONE.len;\nend\n\n-- The debuffs on a boss or guardian by its id: { spell, name, icon, stacks, duration,\n-- remaining, permanent, dispelType } each; timings nil when unknown, `remaining` off the run's\n-- clock.\nfunction AZS_GetDebuffs(id)\n
local out = {};\n
local now = AZS_GetRunTime() or 0;\n
for i = 1, table.getn(AZS_DEBUFFS) do\n
local d = AZS_DEBUFFS[i];\n
if ( d.id == id ) then\n
local duration, remaining, permanent, dispel;\n
if ( d.ends >= 0 ) then\n
duration = d.duration;\n
remaining = d.ends - now;\n
if ( remaining < 0 ) then\n
remaining = 0;\n
end\n
end\n
if ( d.permanent == 1 ) then\n
permanent = true;\n
end\n
if ( d.dispel ~= "" ) then\n
dispel = d.dispel;\n
end\n
table.insert(out, { spell = d.spell, name = d.name, icon = d.icon, stacks = d.stacks,\n
duration = duration, remaining = remaining, permanent = permanent, dispelType = dispel });\n
end\n
end\n
return out;\nend\n\n-- Your summons out, every class's (a beast, Treants, Spirit Wolves, a Water Elemental, demons),\n-- in the order they came: { id, entry, key, kind, name, icon, permanent, duration, remaining }\n-- each. `key` its English name in lower case ("imp", "spirit_wolf"); `kind` "pet" or the\n-- demon's ("felguard", "pitlord"...); a temporary one's `duration` and `remaining` (off the\n-- run's clock), nil for one that stays (`permanent`). With `which` (a key or a kind), only those.\nfunction AZS_GetSummons(which)\n
local out = {};\n
local now = AZS_GetRunTime() or 0;\n
for i = 1, table.getn(AZS_PETS) do\n
local p = AZS_PETS[i];\n
if ( not which or p.key == which or p.kind == which ) then\n
local duration, remaining, permanent;\n
if ( p.ends >= 0 ) then\n
duration = p.dur;\n
remaining = p.ends - now;\n
if ( remaining < 0 ) then\n
remaining = 0;\n
end\n
else\n
permanent = true;\n
end\n
local icon;\n
if ( p.icon ~= "" ) then\n
icon = p.icon;\n
end\n
table.insert(out, { id = p.id, entry = p.entry, key = p.key, kind = p.kind, name = p.name,\n
icon = icon, permanent = permanent, duration = duration, remaining = remaining });\n
end\n
end\n
return out;\nend\n\n-- How many summons are out, with `which` (a key or a kind) only those.\nfunction AZS_GetSummonCount(which)\n
return table.getn(AZS_GetSummons(which));\nend\n\n-- Your summons by kind of creature, in the order the first of each came: { key, kind, name,\n-- icon, count, permanent, temporary, remaining } each, `permanent` and `temporary` how many of\n-- the count stay for good or go, `remaining` the time left of the one that goes first (nil if\n-- none goes); and the count of all.\nfunction AZS_GetSummonGroups()\n
local groups = {};\n
local all = AZS_GetSummons();\n
for i = 1, table.getn(all) do\n
local p = all[i];\n
local g;\n
for j = 1, table.getn(groups) do\n
if ( groups[j].key == p.key ) then\n
g = groups[j];\n
end\n
end\n
if ( not g ) then\n
g = { key = p.key, kind = p.kind, name = p.name, icon = p.icon, count = 0, permanent = 0, temporary = 0 };\n
table.insert(groups, g);\n
end\n
g.count = g.count + 1;\n
if ( p.permanent ) then\n
g.permanent = g.permanent + 1;\n
else\n
g.temporary = g.temporary + 1;\n
if ( not g.remaining or p.remaining < g.remaining ) then\n
g.remaining = p.remaining;\n
end\n
end\n
end\n
return groups, table.getn(all);\nend\n\n-- The bosses alive now: { id, name, hp, hpm, final, enraged, debuffs } each, several at once too.\nfunction AZS_GetBosses()\n
local out = {};\n
for i = 1, table.getn(AZS_UNITS) do\n
local u = AZS_UNITS[i];\n
if ( u.kind == "boss" or u.kind == "final" ) then\n
table.insert(out, { id = u.id, name = u.name, hp = u.hp, hpm = u.hpm,\n
final = (u.kind == "final"), enraged = (u.state == 1), debuffs = AZS_GetDebuffs(u.id) });\n
end\n
end\n
return out;\nend\n\n-- The guardians alive now: { id, name, hp, hpm, awake, debuffs } each.\nfunction AZS_GetGuardians()\n
local out = {};\n
for i = 1, table.getn(AZS_UNITS) do\n
local u = AZS_UNITS[i];\n
if ( u.kind == "guardian" ) then\n
table.insert(out, { id = u.id, name = u.name, hp = u.hp, hpm = u.hpm, awake = (u.state == 1),\n
debuffs = AZS_GetDebuffs(u.id) });\n
end\n
end\n
return out;\nend\n\n-- The bosses still to come: { index, name, at, left, final } each, `left` seconds from now.\nfunction AZS_GetUpcomingBosses()\n
local out = {};\n
local now = AZS_GetRunTime() or 0;\n
for i = 1, table.getn(AZS_SCHEDULE) do\n
local b = AZS_SCHEDULE[i];\n
if ( b.state == "due" ) then\n
table.insert(out, { index = b.index, name = b.name, at = b.at, left = b.at - now, final = (b.final == 1) });\n
end\n
end\n
return out;\nend\n\n-- The damage meter: its lines, the most first ({ name, dmg, dps, share, proc }), and the\n-- run's total and damage per second.\nfunction AZS_GetMeter()\n
local total = 0;\n
for i = 1, table.getn(AZS_METER) do\n
total = total + AZS_METER[i].dmg;\n
end\n
local t = AZS_GetRunTime() or 0;\n
if ( t < 1 ) then\n
end\n
return AZS_METER, total, total / t;\nend\n\n-- A meter's lines, its total and its total per second (the sum of the lines' own).\nfunction AZS_MeterTotals(lines)\n
local total, rate = 0, 0;\n
for i = 1, table.getn(lines) do\n
total = total + lines[i].dmg;\n
rate = rate + lines[i].dps;\n
end\n
return lines, total, rate;\nend\n\n-- The healing meter: its lines, the most first ({ name, dmg, dps, share, proc }, `dmg` the\n-- health it gave, overhealing left out, `dps` that per second), the run's total and per second.\nfunction AZS_GetHealing()\n
return AZS_MeterTotals(AZS_HEALING);\nend\n\n-- The last boss fight's meter: the damage dealt to bosses, as AZS_GetMeter, per second over\n-- that fight; empty before the first one.\nfunction AZS_GetBossMeter()\n
return AZS_MeterTotals(AZS_BOSSMETER);\nend\n\n-- A party's revives: { down, share, by, reviving, rshare }. `down` 1 while the hero is down,\n-- `share` how far (0 to 1) it is brought back and `by` the friend bringing it; `reviving` the\n-- friend down the hero stands over and `rshare` how far that one is. Empty out of a party.\n-- The talents' (and jewelry's) own clocks, the ones the build shows counting down and every\n-- wait a talent keeps: { name, icon, kind, duration, remaining, ready } each. `kind` "summon" (Pact\n-- of the Annihilan's or Butcher's next demon, Legion Gate's next wave) or "cooldown" (a proc's,\n-- a heal's or a second life's wait between two goes); `duration` the whole wait, `remaining` off\n-- the run's clock, 0 and `ready` true when it may go now. With `name`, only that talent's.\nfunction AZS_GetTimers(name)\n
local out = {};\n
local now = AZS_GetRunTime() or 0;\n
for i = 1, table.getn(AZS_TIMERS) do\n
local t = AZS_TIMERS[i];\n
if ( not name or t.name == name ) then\n
local remaining = t.ready - now;\n
if ( remaining < 0 ) then\n
remaining = 0;\n
end\n
table.insert(out, { name = t.name, icon = t.icon, kind = t.kind, duration = t.wait,\n
remaining = remaining, ready = remaining == 0 });\n
end\n
end\n
return out;\nend\n\nfunction AZS_GetRevive()\n
return AZS_REVIVE;\nend\n\n-- A party's damage meter: a line a hero, the most damage first ({ name, class, dmg, dps, share,\n-- top, topdps }: `class` the class's key, `top` the hero's spell that dealt the most, `topdps`\n-- its damage per second), the party's total and per second. Empty out of a party.\nfunction AZS_GetPartyMeter()\n
return AZS_MeterTotals(AZS_PARTY);\nend\n\n-- The guardians' lairs, each with `active` true while a guardian holds it.\nfunction AZS_GetLairs()\n
for i = 1, table.getn(AZS_LAIRS) do\n
AZS_LAIRS[i].active = (AZS_LAIRS[i].state ~= "empty");\n
end\n
return AZS_LAIRS;\nend\n\n-- The lair the minimap's flag points at (the nearest held, else the one that fills soonest),\n-- shown or not; nil before the first.\nfunction AZS_GetFlaggedLair()\n
local lairs = AZS_GetLairs();\n
for i = 1, table.getn(lairs) do\n
if ( lairs[i].flag == 1 ) then\n
return lairs[i];\n
end\n
end\nend\n\n-- The run's end, as the end screen shows it, once the hero fell, left or won: nil while the\n-- run goes on.\nfunction AZS_GetRunSummary()\n
if ( not AZS_END.result ) then\n
return nil;\n
end\n
return AZS_END;\nend\n\n-- The level-ups stored (Store Level-Ups), waiting to be opened; 0 with the setting off.\nfunction AZS_GetStoredLevels()\n
return AZS_RUN.sl or 0;\nend\n\n-- Open the stored level-ups, as the HUD's Level Up! button does: each is offered in turn.\nfunction AZS_OpenStoredLevels()\n
SetCVar("spendLevels", "1");\nend\n\n-- Whether level-ups are stored instead of offered as they come (Store Level-Ups).\nfunction AZS_IsStoringLevels()\n
return GetCVar("storeLevels") == "1";\nend\n\n-- Turn Store Level-Ups on or off, kept as the Controls page's setting; turned off, the levels\n-- stored so far are offered at once.\nfunction AZS_SetStoringLevels(on)\n
if ( on ) then\n
SetCVar("storeLevels", "1");\n
else\n
SetCVar("storeLevels", "0");\n
end\nend\n\n-- The run's own screens: clock, bosses, tally, build, banners, loot, meter, levels, flag (the\n-- minimap's flag on the nearest guardian), and revive (a party's revive bar and "you are down" line).\nAZS_HUD_CVARS = { HUD_CVARS_LUA };\n\n-- Show or hide one of the run's screens, or all of them for `part` nil or "all"; kept as the\n-- Interface page's setting.\nfunction AZS_SetHudShown(part, shown)\n
local value = "0";\n
if ( shown ) then\n
value = "1";\n
end\n
if ( not part or part == "all" ) then\n
for _, cvar in pairs(AZS_HUD_CVARS) do\n
SetCVar(cvar, value);\n
end\n
elseif ( AZS_HUD_CVARS[part] ) then\n
SetCVar(AZS_HUD_CVARS[part], value);\n
end\nend\n\nfunction AZS_IsHudShown(part)\n
local cvar = AZS_HUD_CVARS[part];\n
return cvar and GetCVar(cvar) ~= "0";\nend\n\n-- The banners kept for AZS_BANNERS, the newest last.\nAZS_BANNERS_KEPT = 20;\n\n-- Call `handler(banner)` for every banner from now on ({ id, kind, boss, name, text, time }),\n-- shown or hidden; once per handler however often it is registered.\nfunction AZS_RegisterBannerHandler(handler)\n
for i = 1, table.getn(AZS_BANNER_HANDLERS) do\n
if ( AZS_BANNER_HANDLERS[i] == handler ) then\n
return;\n
end\n
end\n
table.insert(AZS_BANNER_HANDLERS, handler);\nend\n\nfunction AZS_UnregisterBannerHandler(handler)\n
for i = table.getn(AZS_BANNER_HANDLERS), 1, -1 do\n
if ( AZS_BANNER_HANDLERS[i] == handler ) then\n
table.remove(AZS_BANNER_HANDLERS, i);\n
end\n
end\nend\n\n-- A banner line: its fields, the text last and whole.\nfunction AZS_ParseBanner(msg)\n
local _, _, id, kind, boss, name, text = string.find(msg, "^id=(%d+);kind=(%w+);boss=(%d);name=([^;]*);text=(.*)$");\n
if ( not id ) then\n
return nil;\n
end\n
return { id = tonumber(id), kind = kind, boss = (boss == "1"), name = name, text = text, time = GetTime() };\nend\n\nfunction AZS_OnBanner(msg)\n
local b = AZS_ParseBanner(msg);\n
if ( not b ) then\n
return;\n
end\n
AZS_BANNER = b;\n
table.insert(AZS_BANNERS, b);\n
while ( table.getn(AZS_BANNERS) > AZS_BANNERS_KEPT ) do\n
table.remove(AZS_BANNERS, 1);\n
end\n
AZS_BANNER_UPDATED = b.time;\n
-- One addon's error leaves the others theirs: it goes to the error handler, as a script's would.\n
for i = 1, table.getn(AZS_BANNER_HANDLERS) do\n
local ok, err = pcall(AZS_BANNER_HANDLERS[i], b);\n
if ( not ok and geterrorhandler ) then\n
geterrorhandler()(err);\n
end\n
end\nend\n\nfunction AZS_UnitKind(unit)\n
if ( not UnitExists(unit) or UnitIsPlayer(unit) or UnitPlayerControlled(unit) ) then\n
return nil;\n
end\n
local name = UnitName(unit);\n
if ( UnitIsUnit(unit, "target") and AZS_TARGET.name == name ) then\n
return AZS_TARGET.kind;\n
end\n
for i = 1, table.getn(AZS_UNITS) do\n
local u = AZS_UNITS[i];\n
if ( u.name == name and ( u.kind == "final" or u.kind == "boss" ) ) then\n
return u.kind;\n
end\n
end\n
local c = UnitClassification(unit);\n
if ( c == "worldboss" ) then\n
return "boss";\n
elseif ( c == "elite" or c == "rareelite" ) then\n
return "elite";\n
end\n
return "normal";\nend\n\nfunction AZS_ApiOnEvent()\n
if ( event ~= "CHAT_MSG_ADDON" ) then\n
return;\n
end\n
if ( arg1 == "AZSRUN" ) then\n
AZS_RUN = AZS_Fields(arg2);\n
AZS_RUN_UPDATED = GetTime();\n
elseif ( arg1 == "AZSZONE" ) then\n
AZS_ZONE = AZS_Fields(arg2);\n
AZS_ZONE_UPDATED = GetTime();\n
elseif ( arg1 == "AZSBOSSES" ) then\n
AZS_SCHEDULE = AZS_List(arg2, { "index", "at", "name", "final", "state" });\n
AZS_SCHEDULE_UPDATED = GetTime();\n
elseif ( arg1 == "AZSUNITS" ) then\n
AZS_UNITS = AZS_List(arg2, { "kind", "id", "name", "hp", "hpm", "state" });\n
AZS_UNITS_UPDATED = GetTime();\n
elseif ( arg1 == "AZSDEBUFFS" ) then\n
AZS_DEBUFFS = AZS_List(arg2, { "id", "spell", "stacks", "duration", "ends", "permanent", "dispel", "icon", "name" });\n
AZS_DEBUFFS_UPDATED = GetTime();\n
elseif ( arg1 == "AZSTGT" ) then\n
AZS_TARGET = AZS_Fields(arg2);\n
AZS_TARGET_UPDATED = GetTime();\n
elseif ( arg1 == "AZSSPELLS" ) then\n
AZS_SPELLS = AZS_List(arg2, { "key", "spell", "rank", "cd", "cdmax" });\n
AZS_SPELLS_UPDATED = GetTime();\n
elseif ( arg1 == "AZSTIMERS" ) then\n
AZS_TIMERS = AZS_List(arg2, { "name", "icon", "kind", "ready", "wait" });\n
AZS_TIMERS_UPDATED = GetTime();\n
elseif ( arg1 == "AZSBUFFS" ) then\n
AZS_BUFFS = AZS_List(arg2, { "spell", "left" });\n
AZS_BUFFS_UPDATED = GetTime();\n
elseif ( arg1 == "AZSPETS" ) then\n
AZS_PETS = AZS_List(arg2, { "id", "entry", "key", "kind", "ends", "dur", "icon", "name" });\n
AZS_PETS_UPDATED = GetTime();\n
elseif ( arg1 == "AZSMETER" ) then\n
AZS_METER = AZS_List(arg2, { "name", "dmg", "dps", "share", "proc" });\n
AZS_METER_UPDATED = GetTime();\n
elseif ( arg1 == "AZSHEAL" ) then\n
AZS_HEALING = AZS_List(arg2, { "name", "dmg", "dps", "share", "proc" });\n
AZS_HEALING_UPDATED = GetTime();\n
elseif ( arg1 == "AZSBOSSDMG" ) then\n
AZS_BOSSMETER = AZS_List(arg2, { "name", "dmg", "dps", "share", "proc" });\n
AZS_BOSSMETER_UPDATED = GetTime();\n
elseif ( arg1 == "AZSREVIVE" ) then\n
AZS_REVIVE = AZS_Fields(arg2);\n
AZS_REVIVE_UPDATED = GetTime();\n
elseif ( arg1 == "AZSPARTY" ) then\n
AZS_PARTY = AZS_List(arg2, { "name", "class", "dmg", "dps", "share", "top", "topdps" });\n

\n\n-- Azeroth Survivors: the run's numbers on the character pane, off the server's addon line.\nAZS_STATS = nil;\n\nfunction AZS_Parse(msg)\n
local t = {};\n
local pos = 1;\n
while ( true ) do\n
local s, e, k, v = string.find(msg, "(%w+)=([^;]*)", pos);\n
if ( not s ) then\n
break;\n
end\n
t[k] = tonumber(v) or 0;\n
pos = e + 1;\n
end\n
return t;\nend\n\nfunction AZS_Pct(v)\n
return string.format("%+.0f%%", v * 100);\nend\n\nfunction AZS_Gear(v, text)\n
if ( v and v ~= 0 ) then\n
return "\n"..GREEN_FONT_COLOR_CODE.."Worn gear: "..text..FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE;\n
end\n
return "";\nend\n\nfunction AZS_RowEnter()\n
GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT");\n
GameTooltip:SetText(this.azsTitle, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0);\n
GameTooltip:AddLine(this.azsText, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.r, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.g, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.b, 1);\n
GameTooltip:Show();\nend\n\nfunction AZS_Row(name, label, value, text)\n
local frame = getglobal(name);\n
if ( not frame ) then\n
return;\n
end\n
getglobal(name.."Label"):SetText(label..":");\n
getglobal(name.."StatText"):SetText(value);\n
frame.azsTitle = label.." "..value;\n
frame.azsText = text;\n
if ( not frame.azs ) then\n
frame.azs = 1;\n
frame:SetScript("OnEnter", AZS_RowEnter);\n
end\nend\n\nfunction AZS_Update()\n
local s = AZS_STATS;\n
AZS_Row("CharacterStatFrame1", "Health", string.format("%.0f", s.hp),\n
"The most health you can have."..AZS_Gear(s.ghp, string.format("+%.0f health", s.ghp)));\n
AZS_Row("CharacterStatFrame2", "Damage", AZS_Pct(s.dmg - 1),\n
"Every spell you cast deals this much more damage. It grows with your level, gear, talents, jewelry and buffs."\n
..AZS_Gear(s.gdmg, AZS_Pct(s.gdmg).." damage"));\n
AZS_Row("CharacterStatFrame3", "Haste", AZS_Pct(1 - s.cd),\n
"Your spells come back this much sooner."\n
..AZS_Gear(s.gcd, AZS_Pct(s.gcd).." cooldown reduction"));\n
AZS_Row("CharacterStatFrame4", "Crit", string.format("%.1f%%", s.crit * 100),\n
"The chance a spell strikes critically. Past 100%, the rest adds to your critical damage."\n
..AZS_Gear(s.gcrit, AZS_Pct(s.gcrit).." critical strike"));\n
AZS_Row("CharacterStatFrame5", "Crit Dmg", string.format("%.0f%%", s.cm * 100),\n
"A critical strike deals this much of a spell's damage."\n
..AZS_Gear(s.gcm, AZS_Pct(s.gcm).." critical damage"));\n
AZS_Row("CharacterArmorFrame", "Armor", string.format("%.0f%%", s.arm * 100),\n
"Damage you take is reduced by this much (60% at most)."\n
..AZS_Gear(s.garm, AZS_Pct(s.garm).." damage reduction"));\n
AZS_Row("CharacterAttackFrame", "Area", AZS_Pct(s.area - 1),\n
"Your spells' areas and ranges are this much larger."\n
..AZS_Gear(s.garea, AZS_Pct(s.garea).." area"));\n
AZS_Row("CharacterAttackPowerFrame", "Targets", string.format("+%d", s.cnt),\n
"Every spell that picks its targets picks this many more."\n
..AZS_Gear(s.gcnt, string.format("+%d targets", s.gcnt)));\n
AZS_Row("CharacterDamageFrame", "Echo", string.format("%.0f%%", s.echo * 100),\n
"The chance a spell strikes twice. Past 100%, every spell strikes twice and the rest is the chance of a third."\n
..AZS_Gear(s.gecho, AZS_Pct(s.gecho).." echo"));\n
AZS_Row("CharacterRangedAttackFrame", "Speed", AZS_Pct(s.spd - 1),\n
"You run this much faster."..AZS_Gear(s.gspd, AZS_Pct(s.gspd).." movement speed"));\n
AZS_Row("CharacterRangedAttackPowerFrame", "Regen", string.format("%.1f", s.reg),\n
"Health you regain every second."\n
..AZS_Gear(s.greg, string.format("+%.1f health per second", s.greg)));\n
AZS_Row("CharacterRangedDamageFrame", "Pickup", string.format("%.0f yd", s.pick),\n
"Experience and gold fly to you from this far."\n
..AZS_Gear(s.gpick, AZS_Pct(s.gpick).." pickup range"));\n
CharacterResistanceFrame:Hide();\n
AZS_UpdateMore();\nend\n\n-- The rest of the run's numbers, in a panel beside the pane: always the first rows, the\n-- conditional damage rows only once something raises them.\nAZS_MORE_ROWS = {};\n\nfunction AZS_MoreRow(i)\n
local row = AZS_MORE_ROWS[i];\n
if ( row ) then\n
return row;\n
end\n
row = CreateFrame("Frame", "AZSMoreStat"..i, AZSMoreStats);\n
row:SetWidth(156);\n
row:SetHeight(13);\n
row:EnableMouse(1);\n
row:SetScript("OnEnter", AZS_RowEnter);\n
row:SetScript("OnLeave", function() GameTooltip:Hide(); end);\n
row.label = row:CreateFontString("AZSMoreStat"..i.."Label", "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalSmall");\n
row.label:SetPoint("LEFT", row, "LEFT", 0, 0);\n
row.value = row:CreateFontString("AZSMoreStat"..i.."StatText", "OVERLAY", "GameFontHighlightSmall");\n
row.value:SetPoint("RIGHT", row, "RIGHT", 0, 0);\n
AZS_MORE_ROWS[i] = row;\n
return row;\nend\n\nfunction AZS_UpdateMore()\n
if ( not AZSMoreStats ) then\n
AZSMoreStats = CreateFrame("Frame", "AZSMoreStats", PaperDollFrame);\n
AZSMoreStats:SetWidth(180);\n
AZSMoreStats:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", CharacterFrame, "TOPRIGHT", -34, -14);\n
AZSMoreStats:SetBackdrop({\n
bgFile = "Interface\\DialogFrame\\UI-DialogBox-Background",\n
edgeFile = "Interface\\Tooltips\\UI-Tooltip-Border",\n
tile = true, tileSize = 16, edgeSize = 16,\n
insets = { left = 4, right = 4, top = 4, bottom = 4 },\n
AZSMoreStats:SetBackdropBorderColor(0.6, 0.6, 0.6, 1.0);\n
local title = AZSMoreStats:CreateFontString("AZSMoreStatsTitle", "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormal");\n
title:SetPoint("TOP", AZSMoreStats, "TOP", 0, -10);\n

moveAccountLoginRealmlist.xml<Ui xmlns="http://www.blizzard.com/wow/ui/">
\n    <!-- benilla's realmlist control on the stock login screen: a button over the Cinematics one,
\n         the address the next login dials beside it, and the stock GlueDialog with its edit box to
\n         change it. The address is the realmList CVar, written through ConsoleExec; the host keeps
\n         BENILLA_REALMLIST and BENILLA_REALMLIST_PINNED (set while $WOW_HOST fixes the address),
\n         and reopens the dialog with the typed text when it is not an address. -->
\n    <Script>
\n        GlueDialogTypes["BENILLA_REALMLIST"] = {
\n            -- The realmList CVar's registered help text.
\n            text = "Address of realm list server",
\n            button1 = TEXT(OKAY),
\n            button2 = TEXT(CANCEL),
\n            hasEditBox = 1,
\n            maxLetters = 64,
\n            OnShow = function()
\n                BenillaRealmlist_TakeEditBox();
\n                GlueDialogEditBox:SetText(GlueDialog.data or BENILLA_REALMLIST or "");
\n                GlueDialogEditBox:HighlightText();
\n                GlueDialogEditBox:SetFocus();
\n            end,
\n            OnAccept = function()
\n                local typed = GlueDialogEditBox:GetText();
\n                BenillaRealmlist_ReleaseEditBox();
\n                if ( typed and typed ~= "" ) then
\n                    ConsoleExec("realmList "..typed);
\n                end
\n            end,
\n            OnCancel = function()
\n                BenillaRealmlist_ReleaseEditBox();
\n            end,
\n        GlueDialogTypes["BENILLA_REALMLIST_PINNED"] = {
\n            text = "",
\n            button1 = TEXT(OKAY),
\n            button2 = nil,
\n        -- The stock edit box's Enter and Escape call the in-game StaticPopup functions, which the
\n        -- glue does not have: while this dialog owns it, they press its buttons, and it is wide
\n        -- enough for a host name. The stock border is two 75-pixel caps that meet at its own 130
\n        -- pixels, so the widened box also takes the chat box's stretched middle piece
\n        -- (ChatFrame.xml:41-55) between them.
\n        function BenillaRealmlist_TakeEditBox()
\n            if ( not BenillaRealmlist_Saved ) then
\n                BenillaRealmlist_Saved = {
\n                    width = GlueDialogEditBox:GetWidth(),
\n                    enter = GlueDialogEditBox:GetScript("OnEnterPressed"),
\n                    escape = GlueDialogEditBox:GetScript("OnEscapePressed"),
\n            end
\n            GlueDialogEditBox:SetWidth(300);
\n            if ( not BenillaRealmlist_Middle ) then
\n                BenillaRealmlist_Middle = GlueDialogEditBox:CreateTexture(nil, "BACKGROUND");
\n                BenillaRealmlist_Middle:SetTexture("Interface\\ChatFrame\\UI-ChatInputBorder-Right");
\n                BenillaRealmlist_Middle:SetTexCoord(0, 0.9375, 0, 1.0);
\n                BenillaRealmlist_Middle:SetHeight(32);
\n                BenillaRealmlist_Middle:SetPoint("LEFT", GlueDialogEditBox, "LEFT", 65, 0);
\n                BenillaRealmlist_Middle:SetPoint("RIGHT", GlueDialogEditBox, "RIGHT", -65, 0);
\n            end
\n            BenillaRealmlist_Middle:Show();
\n            GlueDialogEditBox:SetScript("OnEnterPressed", function() GlueDialogButton1:Click(); end);
\n            GlueDialogEditBox:SetScript("OnEscapePressed", function() GlueDialogButton2:Click(); end);
\n        end
\n        function BenillaRealmlist_ReleaseEditBox()
\n            local saved = BenillaRealmlist_Saved;
\n            if ( saved ) then
\n                BenillaRealmlist_Middle:Hide();
\n                GlueDialogEditBox:SetWidth(saved.width);
\n                GlueDialogEditBox:SetScript("OnEnterPressed", saved.enter);
\n                GlueDialogEditBox:SetScript("OnEscapePressed", saved.escape);
\n                BenillaRealmlist_Saved = nil;
\n            end
\n            GlueDialogEditBox:ClearFocus();
\n        end
\n        function BenillaRealmlist_OnClick()
\n            if ( GlueDialog:IsVisible() ) then
\n                return;
\n            end
\n            PlaySound("gsLoginNewAccount");
\n            if ( BENILLA_REALMLIST_PINNED ) then
\n                GlueDialog_Show("BENILLA_REALMLIST_PINNED", format(
\n                    "$WOW_HOST is set for this session, so the realmlist is fixed at %s.",
\n                    BENILLA_REALMLIST or ""));
\n            else
\n                GlueDialog_Show("BENILLA_REALMLIST", nil, BENILLA_REALMLIST);
\n            end
\n        end
\n    </Script>
\n    <Button name="BenillaRealmlistButton" inherits="GlueButtonSmallTemplate" parent="AccountLoginUI" text="Realmlist">
\n        <Anchors>
\n            <Anchor point="BOTTOM" relativeTo="AccountLoginCinematicsButton" relativePoint="TOP">
\n                <Offset>
\n                    <AbsDimension x="0" y="-2"/>
\n                </Offset>
\n            </Anchor>
\n        </Anchors>
\n        <Layers>
\n            <Layer level="BACKGROUND">
\n                <FontString name="BenillaRealmlistText" inherits="GlueFontDisableSmall" justifyH="RIGHT">
\n                    <Size>
\n                        <AbsDimension x="256" y="0"/>
\n                    </Size>
\n                    <Anchors>
\n                        <Anchor point="RIGHT" relativePoint="LEFT">
\n                            <Offset>
\n                                <AbsDimension x="-4" y="3"/>
\n                            </Offset>
\n                        </Anchor>
\n                    </Anchors>
\n                </FontString>
\n            </Layer>
\n        </Layers>
\n        <Scripts>
\n            <OnClick>
\n                BenillaRealmlist_OnClick();
\n            </OnClick>
\n            <OnUpdate>
\n                if ( BenillaRealmlistText:GetText() ~= BENILLA_REALMLIST ) then
\n                    BenillaRealmlistText:SetText(BENILLA_REALMLIST);
\n                end
\n            </OnUpdate>
\n        </Scripts>
\n    </Button>
\nContainerFrameAdapters.xml<!--
\n    Adapters over the stock ContainerFrame.xml and .lua; loaded after them, so these win.
\n    A full keyring prints an empty error line as the reference does: `PutKeyInKeyRing` reads
\n    `NO_EMPTY_KEYRING_SLOTS`, which 1.12 does not ship.
\n<Ui xmlns="http://www.blizzard.com/wow/ui/">
\n    <Script><![CDATA[
\n        -- ══ The two bag verbs benilla answers differently ═════════════════════════════════════
\n        -- Deviation: `OpenBackpack` opens every equipped bag, not only the backpack, so the vendor
\n        -- and mailbox windows that call it (MerchantFrame.lua:35, MailFrame.lua:39) bring up every
\n        -- bag to sell or mail from. The was-open memory is keyed by bag id: `ContainerFrame1..12`

\n        BENILLA_BAG_WAS_OPEN = {}
\n        -- The reference's `backpackWasOpen`, one entry per bag: CloseBackpack leaves those open.
\n        function BenillaOpenBackpack()
\n            for bagId = 0, (NUM_BAG_FRAMES or -1) do
\n                -- OpenBag's own test, repeated so the memory agrees with it.
\n                if bagId == 0 or GetContainerNumSlots(bagId) > 0 then
\n                    if IsBagOpen(bagId) then
\n                        BENILLA_BAG_WAS_OPEN[bagId] = 1
\n                    else
\n                        BENILLA_BAG_WAS_OPEN[bagId] = nil
\n                        OpenBag(bagId)
\n                    end
\n                end
\n            end
\n        end
\n        function BenillaCloseBackpack()
\n            for bagId = 0, (NUM_BAG_FRAMES or -1) do
\n                if not BENILLA_BAG_WAS_OPEN[bagId] then
\n                    CloseBag(bagId)
\n                end
\n            end
\n        end

\n        CloseBackpack = BenillaCloseBackpack

\n        The script error log, which 1.12 does not have, so every name carries the `Benilla` prefix;
\n        the stock `ScriptErrors` dialog shows one message, this keeps the log. Laid out on the
\n        ClassTrainer panel art as the class trainer lays itself out (Blizzard_TrainerUI.xml:214-356
\n        and :481-513, Blizzard_TrainerUI.lua:469-474): its rows, its list, its detail under the
\n        list and its two buttons in the art's sockets. It collects as a 1.12 error-log addon does:
\n        it wraps the handler `geterrorhandler` holds, the stock `_ERRORMESSAGE`
\n        (BasicControls.xml:16), which still runs after it. An addon that later calls
\n        `seterrorhandler` replaces the chain, as in 1.12.
\n    <Script><![CDATA[
\n        -- A pushable above every stock panel's, so a game window opening pushes the log aside.
\n        UIPanelWindows["BenillaScriptLogFrame"] = { area = "left", pushable = 9, whileDead = 1 }
\n        -- The class trainer's rows (`CLASS_TRAINER_SKILLS_DISPLAYED`, Blizzard_TrainerUI.lua:470).
\n        BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROWS = 11
\n        BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_HEIGHT = 16
\n        -- A wrapped row would break the faux kit's fixed rows.
\n        BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_CHARS = 52
\n        -- A `seq`, not an index: indices shift when the cap evicts.
\n        BenillaScriptLogSelected = nil
\n        -- Distinct messages kept before the oldest is evicted.
\n        BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_CAP = 256
\n        -- Rows oldest first, each { seq, message, count }; `total` is the last `seq` handed out,
\n        -- kept apart from the row count so an eviction or a clear never renumbers.
\n        BenillaScriptLog = { rows = {}, total = 0 }
\n        -- A repeat bumps its row's count and keeps its place.
\n        function BenillaScriptLog_Record(message)
\n            if type(message) ~= "string" then message = tostring(message) end
\n            local log = BenillaScriptLog
\n            local found = nil
\n            for i = 1, table.getn(log.rows) do
\n                if log.rows[i].message == message then found = log.rows[i] end
\n            end
\n            if found then
\n                found.count = found.count + 1
\n            else
\n                log.total = log.total + 1
\n                if table.getn(log.rows) >= BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_CAP then table.remove(log.rows, 1) end
\n                table.insert(log.rows, { seq = log.total, message = message, count = 1 })
\n            end
\n            if BenillaScriptLogFrame and BenillaScriptLogFrame:IsVisible() then
\n                BenillaScriptLog_Update()
\n            end
\n        end
\n        -- The chain: the log first, guarded so a fault in it cannot stop the stock handler.
\n        local benillaStockErrorHandler = geterrorhandler()
\n        seterrorhandler(function(message)
\n            pcall(BenillaScriptLog_Record, message)
\n            return benillaStockErrorHandler(message)
\n        end)
\n        -- `strsub` counts bytes, so the cut backs up over UTF-8 continuation bytes (0x80..0xBF).
\n        function BenillaScriptLog_RowText(message)
\n            local cut = strfind(message, "\n", 1, 1)
\n            local head = message
\n            if cut then head = strsub(message, 1, cut - 1) end
\n            if strlen(head) > BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_CHARS then
\n                local last = BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_CHARS - 3
\n                while last > 0 do
\n                    local b = strbyte(head, last + 1)
\n                    if not b or b < 128 or b >= 192 then break end
\n                    last = last - 1
\n                end
\n                head = strsub(head, 1, last) .. "..."
\n            end
\n            return head
\n        end
\n        function BenillaScriptLog_Update()
\n            local shown = table.getn(BenillaScriptLog.rows)
\n            local total = BenillaScriptLog.total
\n            local summary
\n            if total == 0 then
\n                summary = "No problems this session."
\n            elseif total > shown then
\n                summary = format("%d problems (%d older not kept)", total, total - shown)
\n            elseif total == 1 then
\n                summary = "1 problem"
\n            else
\n                summary = format("%d problems", total)
\n            end
\n            getglobal("BenillaScriptLogSummary"):SetText(summary)
\n            local scrollFrame = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogListScrollFrame")
\n            FauxScrollFrame_Update(scrollFrame, shown, BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROWS, BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_HEIGHT)
\n            BenillaScrollTrough_Follow("BenillaScriptLogListScrollFrame")
\n            local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scrollFrame)
\n            local selectedRow = nil
\n            for i = 1, BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROWS do
\n                local button = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogRow" .. i)
\n                local index = offset + i
\n                local row = BenillaScriptLog.rows[index]
\n                if row then
\n                    button.seq = row.seq
\n                    button.message = row.message
\n                    -- `#12 x1113`: one deduplicated failure that happened 1,113 times.
\n                    local label = "#" .. row.seq
\n                    if row.count > 1 then label = label .. " x" .. row.count end
\n                    button.index:SetText(label)
\n                    button.label:SetText(BenillaScriptLog_RowText(row.message))
\n                    button:Show()
\n                    if row.seq == BenillaScriptLogSelected then selectedRow = button end
\n                else
\n                    button.seq = nil
\n                    button.message = nil
\n                    button:Hide()
\n                end
\n            end
\n            -- Hides when the row scrolls away, as the reference's CraftFrame does.
\n            local highlight = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogHighlightFrame")
\n            if selectedRow then
\n                highlight:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", selectedRow:GetName(), "TOPLEFT", 0, 0)
\n                highlight:Show()
\n            else
\n                highlight:Hide()
\n            end
\n            BenillaScriptLog_UpdateDetail()
\n        end
\n        -- The selected message in full, traceback and all, in a box a player can select and copy
\n        -- from. A text that has not changed is left alone: `SetText` collapses the selection, so a
\n        -- new error arriving must not undo one about to be copied. A different text takes the
\n        -- keyboard from the box, as a click on another row does.
\n        function BenillaScriptLog_UpdateDetail()
\n            local text = ""
\n            if BenillaScriptLogSelected then
\n                for _, row in ipairs(BenillaScriptLog.rows) do
\n                    if row.seq == BenillaScriptLogSelected then
\n                        text = row.message
\n                        break
\n                    end
\n                end
\n            end
\n            if text == "" then
\n                text = "Select a row above to read it in full."
\n            end
\n            local box = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogDetailText")
\n            if text ~= box.shown then
\n                box.shown = text
\n                box:ClearFocus()
\n                box:SetText(text)
\n            end
\n        end
\n        -- The box is read-only: a player's edit is undone. The restore's own `SetText` raises
\n        -- another change, which finds the text equal and stops; `SetText` of an equal text does
\n        -- nothing. The selection an edit replaced is put back, so Ctrl+C still copies it all.
\n        function BenillaScriptLogDetail_OnTextChanged()
\n            local shown = this.shown or ""
\n            if this:GetText() ~= shown then
\n                this:SetText(shown)
\n                this:HighlightText()
\n            end

\nScrollTemplates.xml<Ui>\n    <!--\n        Benilla's scroll parts: a `Slider` bar with its arrow helpers, an optional trough, and a\n        real-scroll kit that pans a `<ScrollFrame>` child whose height is known only after layout.\n        Faux lists use the stock `FauxScrollFrameTemplate`; this file declares only `Benilla` names.\n        The bar template carries the real-scroll OnValueChanged itself, as the reference's\n        `UIPanelScrollBarTemplate` does (UIPanelTemplates.xml:156-158); an instance adds nothing.\n    -->\n    <Script><![CDATA[\n        -- One valueStep per step, where the reference's arrows and wheel move half the bar\n        -- (UIPanelTemplates.xml:137/149, UIPanelTemplates.lua:150-157).\n        -- Soundless: the reference plays UChatScrollButton on an arrow click, never on the wheel.\n        function BenillaScrollBar_Step(scrollBar, dir)\n            local step = scrollBar:GetValueStep()\n            if step <= 0 then step = 1 end\n            scrollBar:SetValue(scrollBar:GetValue() + dir * step)\n        end\n\n        -- Greys each arrow at its end of the range (reference: ScrollFrame_OnScrollRangeChanged).\n        function BenillaScrollBar_UpdateArrows(scrollBar)\n            local minV, maxV = scrollBar:GetMinMaxValues()\n            local val = scrollBar:GetValue()\n            local up = getglobal(scrollBar:GetName() .. "ScrollUpButton")\n            local down = getglobal(scrollBar:GetName() .. "ScrollDownButton")\n            if val <= minV then up:Disable() else up:Enable() end\n            if val >= maxV then down:Disable() else down:Enable() end\n        end\n\n        -- ReputationFrame's hang, 8 left, 21 above, 20 below (ReputationFrame.xml:573-599 against\n        -- UIPanelTemplates.xml:166-181). "Trough")\n            if trough then BenillaScrollTrough_Seat(trough, scrollBar) end\n            if shown then\n                scrollBar:Show()\n                if trough then trough:Show() end\n            else\n                scrollBar:Hide()\n                if trough then trough:Hide() end\n            end\n        end\n\n        -- For a stock `FauxScrollFrameTemplate` frame; call after `FauxScrollFrame_Update`.\n        function BenillaScrollTrough_Follow(scrollFrameName)\n            local sf = getglobal(scrollFrameName)\n            if not sf then return end\n            local bar = getglobal(scrollFrameName .. BenillaScroll_Range(sf)\n            if target > range then target = range end\n            if target < 0 then target = 0 end\n            sf:SetVerticalScroll(target)\n BenillaScroll_Step(sf, -delta * BENILLA_SCROLL_STEP)\n        end\n\n        -- Nil if hidden, a blank FontString, or not laid out yet.\n        function BenillaScroll_WidgetBottom(w)\n            if \nlayer.toc# benilla's own interface, one layer on the stock one (docs/METHOD.md): every file is ours, from
\n# `assets/ui`, and loads in this order after every `FrameXML.toc` row and before the third-party
\n# addons. It is listed in no addon list, fires no `ADDON_LOADED` and cannot be switched off; a dev
\n# build boots without it under `WOW_STOCK_UI=1`. A test names its files, so it does not grow.
\n## Interface: 11200

\nGameMenuAdapters.xml

benilla_app::shaderssrccrates\benilla-app\src\shaders.rsshaders/ui_quad.wgsl// The player-UI quad material. The reference draws the UI fixed-function into an 8-bit\n// backbuffer, so the fragment tints and premultiplies on gamma bytes and outputs raw gamma for the\n// `(One, OneMinusSrcAlpha)` blend; `ui_gamma.wgsl` decodes once. One pipeline for four modes, a\n// uniform per mode, and a second pipeline for MOD:\n//   DISABLE  (EGxBlend 0, no blend):                    out = (rgb, 1)     ⇒ rgb\n//   ALPHAKEY (EGxBlend 1, no blend, test a ≥ 224/255):  out = (rgb, 1)     ⇒ rgb, or discard\n//   BLEND    (EGxBlend 2, `SrcAlpha/OneMinusSrcAlpha`): out = (rgb·a, a)   ⇒ dst·(1−a) + rgb·a\n//   ADD      (EGxBlend 3, `SrcAlpha/One`):              out = (rgb·a, 0)   ⇒ dst      + rgb·a\n//   MOD      (EGxBlend 4, `DestColor/Zero`, its own pipeline): out = rgb ⇒ dst·rgb\n// Modes 2 to 4 test the alpha at 1/255 (`0x85ad20`), which only MOD can see.\n// `linear_to_srgb` restores the authored byte of every sampled texel except a SKIP_DECODE upload\n// (`gamma_texel`), which already holds it.\n// Deviation: bilinear filtering runs on the decoded texel, not on the gamma byte the reference\n// filters, because the booth bake stores linear bytes.\n\n#import bevy_sprite::mesh2d_functions as mesh_functions\n\n// The mesh vertex at bevy's fixed Mesh2d locations (`Mesh2dPipeline::specialize`: POSITION 0, UV_0\n// 2, COLOR 4); `VERTEX_UVS`/`VERTEX_COLORS` are defined only for attributes the mesh carries.\nstruct Vertex {\n    @builtin(instance_index) instance_index: u32,\n    @location(0) position: vec3<f32>,\n#ifdef VERTEX_UVS\n    @location(2) uv: vec2<f32>,\n#endif\n#ifdef VERTEX_COLORS\n    @location(4) color: vec4<f32>,\n#endif\n}\n\nstruct VertexOutput {\n    // In the fragment, the physical pixel coordinate the screen mask uses.\n    @builtin(position) position: vec4<f32>,\n    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,\n#ifdef VERTEX_COLORS\n    @location(1) color: vec4<f32>,\n#endif\n    // The run's colour from the per-instance `MeshTag`, a byte per channel as the reference's\n    // `CImVector`. Stored complemented, so no `MeshTag` (0) is opaque white.\n    @location(2) @interpolate(flat) tint: vec4<f32>,\n}\n\n@vertex\nfn vertex(vertex: Vertex) -> VertexOutput {\n    var out: VertexOutput;\n    let world_from_local = mesh_functions::get_world_from_local(vertex.instance_index);\n    let world_position = mesh_functions::mesh2d_position_local_to_world(\n        world_from_local,\n        vec4<f32>(vertex.position, 1.0),\n    );\n    out.position = mesh_functions::mesh2d_position_world_to_clip(world_position);\n#ifdef VERTEX_UVS\n    out.uv = vertex.uv;\n#else\n    out.uv = vec2<f32>(0.0);\n#endif\n#ifdef VERTEX_COLORS\n    out.color = vertex.color;\n#endif\n    // `unpack4x8unorm` reads byte 0 into `.x`: r, g, b, a from the low byte up.\n    out.tint = unpack4x8unorm(~mesh_functions::get_tag(vertex.instance_index));\n    return out;\n}\n\n// The EGxBlend, 0 to 4 (`UiQuad::blend`).\n@group(2) @binding(0) var<uniform> blend_mode: u32;\n@group(2) @binding(1) var quad_texture: texture_2d<f32>;\n@group(2) @binding(2) var quad_sampler: sampler;\n// Mask to the inscribed circle: the unit portrait's round stencil, which the reference stamps into\n// its 64² bake.\n@group(2) @binding(3) var<uniform> circular: u32;\n// The screen-anchored alpha mask (the minimap's `MinimapMask.blp`): `mask_rect` is its span in\n// physical px (min.xy, max.xy; z <= x disables); outside it is dropped. Sampled at level 0 because\n// the sample sits in non-uniform control flow.\n@group(2) @binding(4) var<uniform> mask_rect: vec4<f32>;\n@group(2) @binding(5) var mask_texture: texture_2d<f32>;\n@group(2) @binding(6) var mask_sampler: sampler;\n// `Texture:SetDesaturated(1)` binds `Shaders\Pixel\Desaturate.bls` (texture object `+0x128`):\n//     MUL result.color.w   , fragment.color.primary, texel   ; a = vertexColour.a x texel.a\n//     DP3 result.color.xyz , texel, c[0]                     ; rgb = dot(texel.rgb, LUMA)\n// It replaces the MODULATE, so the vertex colour's RGB has no effect, only its alpha. The dot runs\n// on the gamma byte.\n@group(2) @binding(7) var<uniform> desaturate: u32;\n// Set only for a booth bake (portrait, paper doll, dressing room), already premultiplied because\n// its additive particles add light with no coverage; every other texture is straight alpha.\n@group(2) @binding(8) var<uniform> premultiplied: u32;\n// Alpha-test reference, <= 0 disables; only the WMO-interior minimap tiles, which the reference\n// draws under EGxBlend 1: no blend, `glAlphaFunc(GL_GEQUAL, 224/255)` (`0x85ad20[1]`) on\n// `texel.a × frameAlpha`. The screen mask stays out: the reference cuts it at the offscreen blit.\n@group(2) @binding(9) var<uniform> alpha_ref: f32;\n// Uploaded undecoded (`BlpVariant::MapTile`, the minimap tiles): the texel is already the gamma\n// byte. The alpha-test arm ignores this and decodes explicitly.\n@group(2) @binding(10) var<uniform> gamma_texel: u32;\n// The UV window this quad may sample, `(u_min, v_min, u_max, v_max)`, inset half a texel so a\n// magnified atlas cell never filters in its neighbour; `min > max` leaves an axis unclamped.\n@group(2) @binding(11) var<uniform> uv_clamp: vec4<f32>;\n// The mask's stage modulates colour as well as alpha (combine preset 1, the outdoor minimap tile's\n// stage 1, `0x4eae83`): the colour is times the mask texel's bytes.\n@group(2) @binding(12) var<uniform> mask_rgb: u32;\n\n// BT.601 luma, `Desaturate.bls`'s `c[0]` as f32 words `0x3E991687`, `0x3F1645A2`, `0x3DE978D5`.\n// Do not normalise: they sum just above 1.0 and white relies on the output clamp.\nconst LUMA: vec3<f32> = vec3<f32>(0.299, 0.587, 0.114);\n\n// The alpha references `0x85ad20` gives ALPHAKEY (224) and MOD (1), half a byte below so a texel\n// stored at the byte passes `GEQUAL`.\nconst ALPHAKEY_REF: f32 = 223.5 / 255.0;\nconst MOD_REF: f32 = 0.5 / 255.0;\n\n// Linear to sRGB (IEC 61966-2-1), the exact inverse of the sampler's decode in f32.\nfn linear_to_srgb(c: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {\n    let higher = 1.055 * pow(max(c, vec3<f32>(0.0)), vec3<f32>(1.0 / 2.4)) - 0.055;\n    let lower = c * 12.92;\n    return select(higher, lower, c <= vec3<f32>(0.0031308));\n}\n\n// sRGB to linear for an undecoded texture: the reference filters the bytes, then converts.\nfn srgb_to_linear(c: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {\n    let higher = pow((max(c, vec3<f32>(0.0)) + 0.055) / 1.055, vec3<f32>(2.4));\n    let lower = c / 12.92;\n    return select(higher, lower, c <= vec3<f32>(0.04045));\n}\n\n@fragment\nfn fragment(in: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {\n    // Branchless, for implicit derivatives. Sorted because `select` evaluates both arms and a\n    // disabled axis must still hand `clamp` an ordered range.\n    let lo = min(uv_clamp.xy, uv_clamp.zw);\n    let hi = max(uv_clamp.xy, uv_clamp.zw);\n    let uv = select(in.uv, clamp(in.uv, lo, hi), uv_clamp.xy <= uv_clamp.zw);\n    let t = textureSample(quad_texture, quad_sampler, uv);\n#ifdef VERTEX_COLORS\n    let c = in.color * in.tint;\n#else\n    let c = in.tint;\n#endif\n    // The tint is a client-space byte value (`<Color>`, `|cff…`), so `tint × texel` runs on bytes.\n    let texel = select(linear_to_srgb(t.rgb), t.rgb, gamma_texel != 0u);\n    var rgb = texel * c.rgb;\n    if desaturate != 0u {\n        rgb = vec3<f32>(dot(texel, LUMA));\n    }\n    // `m`, the masks' coverage, and `k`, the UI's (frame alpha and masks), stay apart from `t.a`:\n    // `k` scales a premultiplied source's colour and alpha alike, while `t.a` weights only a\n    // straight source.\n    var m = 1.0;\n    if circular != 0u {\n        // A soft edge 2% of the width, like the reference's stencil at portrait size.\n        m *= 1.0 - smoothstep(0.48, 0.5, distance(in.uv, vec2<f32>(0.5)));\n    }\n    if mask_rect.z > mask_rect.x {\n        let muv = (in.position.xy - mask_rect.xy) / (mask_rect.zw - mask_rect.xy);\n        let inside = f32(all(muv >= vec2<f32>(0.0)) && all(muv <= vec2<f32>(1.0)));\n        let ms = textureSampleLevel(mask_texture, mask_sampler, clamp(muv, vec2<f32>(0.0), vec2<f32>(1.0)), 0.0);\n        m *= ms.a * inside;\n        if mask_rgb != 0u {\n            rgb *= ms.rgb;\n        }\n    }\n    let k = c.a * m;\n    // Alpha test: returns the linear texel, not `rgb`, because it draws only into the minimap's\n    // linear 256² composite, whose blit encodes.\n    if alpha_ref > 0.0 {\n        if t.a * c.a < alpha_ref {\n            discard;\n        }\n        return vec4<f32>(srgb_to_linear(t.rgb) * c.rgb, 1.0);\n    }\n    switch blend_mode {\n        // DISABLE and ALPHAKEY write the texel over the target; the masks still cut it.\n        case 0u: {\n            return vec4<f32>(rgb * m, m);\n        }\n        // An ALPHAKEY quad that reaches here has no colour array (the extract promotes one that\n        // does), so the diffuse it tests against is white: the texel alone.\n        case 1u: {\n            if t.a < ALPHAKEY_REF {\n                discard;\n            }\n            return vec4<f32>(rgb * m, m);\n        }\n        // MOD multiplies the target by the texel; a masked-out fragment multiplies by 1.\n        case 4u: {\n            // The test reads texel times vertex colour, the combine preset's alpha.\n            if t.a * c.a < MOD_REF {\n                discard;\n            }\n            return vec4<f32>(mix(vec3<f32>(1.0), rgb, m), 1.0);\n        }\n        default: {}\n    }\n    let a = t.a * k;\n    // Premultiply in gamma, not by the hardware `SrcAlpha`. A booth bake takes `k` alone: `t.a`\n    // again would zero its additive light over empty space.\n    let weight = select(a, k, premultiplied != 0u);\n    if blend_mode == 3u {\n        return vec4<f32>(rgb * weight, 0.0);\n    }\n    return vec4<f32>(rgb * weight, a);\n}\n

shaders/ui_gamma.wgsl// The UI lane's one gamma decode, after the display-gamma ramp: the sampled value is the byte the

\n#import bevy_core_pipeline::fullscreen_vertex_shader::FullscreenVertexOutput
\n@group(0) @binding(0) var screen_texture: texture_2d<f32>;

\n// `.x` = the `gamma` CVar; the rest is padding (a uniform is 16-byte aligned).

\nfn srgb_to_linear(c: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {

\nfn fs_decode(in: FullscreenVertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {

\n    var rgb = ui.rgb;

\n    // an exact identity and the floor guards `log2(0)` inside `pow`.
\n    if (ramp.x != 1.0) {

\n    return vec4<f32>(srgb_to_linear(rgb), ui.a);
shaders/ui_node_gamma.wgsl// The glue screens' Bevy UI node shader, vendored from `bevy_ui_render` 0.18.1 `src/ui.wgsl`,

\nconst TEXTURED = 1u;
\nconst RIGHT_VERTEX = 2u;
\nconst BOTTOM_VERTEX = 4u;
\n// must align with BORDER_* shader_flags from bevy_ui/render/mod.rs

\nconst BORDER_ANY: u32 = BORDER_LEFT + BORDER_TOP + BORDER_RIGHT + BORDER_BOTTOM;
\nfn enabled(flags: u32, mask: u32) -> bool {

\n// Linear to sRGB (IEC 61966-2-1), the exact inverse of the sampler's decode; keep identical to
\n// `ui_quad.wgsl`'s.

\n    let higher = 1.055 * pow(max(c, vec3<f32>(0.0)), vec3<f32>(1.0 / 2.4)) - 0.055;
\n    let lower = c * 12.92;
\n    return select(higher, lower, c <= vec3<f32>(0.0031308));
\n@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> view: View;
\nstruct VertexOutput {
\n    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
\n    @location(1) color: vec4<f32>,
\n    @location(2) @interpolate(flat) size: vec2<f32>,
\n    @location(3) @interpolate(flat) flags: u32,

\n@group(1) @binding(0) var sprite_texture: texture_2d<f32>;
\n@group(1) @binding(1) var sprite_sampler: sampler;
\n// The returned value is the shortest distance from the given point to the boundary of the rounded
\n// box.
\n// Negative values indicate that the point is inside the rounded box, positive values that the point
\n// is outside, and zero is exactly on the boundary.
\n// Arguments:
\n//  - `point`        -> The function will return the distance from this point to the closest point on
\n//                    the boundary.
\n//  - `size`         -> The maximum width and height of the box.
\n//  - `corner_radii` -> The radius of each rounded corner. Ordered counter clockwise starting
\n//                    top left:
\n//                      x: top left, y: top right, z: bottom right, w: bottom left.
\nfn sd_rounded_box(point: vec2<f32>, size: vec2<f32>, corner_radii: vec4<f32>) -> f32 {
\n    // If 0.0 < y then select bottom left (w) and bottom right corner radius (z).
\n    // Else select top left (x) and top right corner radius (y).
\n    let rs = select(corner_radii.xy, corner_radii.wz, 0.0 < point.y);
\n    // w and z are swapped above so that both pairs are in left to right order, otherwise this second
\n    // select statement would return the incorrect value for the bottom pair.
\n    let radius = select(rs.x, rs.y, 0.0 < point.x);
\n    // Vector from the corner closest to the point, to the point.
\n    let corner_to_point = abs(point) - 0.5 * size;
\n    // Vector from the center of the radius circle to the point.
\n    let q = corner_to_point + radius;
\n    // Length from center of the radius circle to the point, zeros a component if the point is not
\n    // within the quadrant of the radius circle that is part of the curved corner.
\n    let l = length(max(q, vec2(0.0)));
\n    let m = min(max(q.x, q.y), 0.0);
\n    return l + m - radius;
\nfn sd_inset_rounded_box(point: vec2<f32>, size: vec2<f32>, radius: vec4<f32>, inset: vec4<f32>) -> f32 {
\n    let inner_size = size - inset.xy - inset.zw;
\n    let inner_center = inset.xy + 0.5 * inner_size - 0.5 * size;
\n    let inner_point = point - inner_center;
\n    var r = radius;
\n    // Top left corner.
\n    r.x = r.x - max(inset.x, inset.y);
\n    // Top right corner.
\n    r.y = r.y - max(inset.z, inset.y);
\n    // Bottom right corner.
\n    r.z = r.z - max(inset.z, inset.w);
\n    // Bottom left corner.
\n    r.w = r.w - max(inset.x, inset.w);
\n    let half_size = inner_size * 0.5;
\n    let min_size = min(half_size.x, half_size.y);
\n    r = min(max(r, vec4(0.0)), vec4<f32>(min_size));
\n    return sd_rounded_box(inner_point, inner_size, r);
\nfn nearest_border_active(point_vs_mid: vec2<f32>, size: vec2<f32>, width: vec4<f32>, flags: u32) -> bool {
\n    if (flags & BORDER_ANY) == BORDER_ANY {
\n        return true;
\n    // get point vs top left
\n    let point = clamp(point_vs_mid + size * 0.49999, vec2(0.0), size);
\n    let left = point.x / width.x;
\n    let top = point.y / width.y;
\n    let right = (size.x - point.x) / width.z;
\n    let bottom = (size.y - point.y) / width.w;
\n    let min_dist = min(min(left, top), min(right, bottom));
\n    return (enabled(flags, BORDER_LEFT) && min_dist == left) ||
\n        (enabled(flags, BORDER_TOP) && min_dist == top) ||
\n        (enabled(flags, BORDER_RIGHT) && min_dist == right) ||
\n        (enabled(flags, BORDER_BOTTOM) && min_dist == bottom);
\n// get alpha for antialiasing for sdf
\nfn antialias(distance: f32) -> f32 {
\n    // Using the fwidth(distance) was causing artifacts, so just use the distance.
\n    return saturate(0.5 - distance);
\nfn draw_uinode_border(
\n    color: vec4<f32>,
\n    point: vec2<f32>,
\n    size: vec2<f32>,
\n    radius: vec4<f32>,
\n    border: vec4<f32>,
\n    flags: u32,
\n) -> vec4<f32> {
\n    // Signed distances. The magnitude is the distance of the point from the edge of the shape.
\n    // * Negative values indicate that the point is inside the shape.
\n    // * Zero values indicate the point is on the edge of the shape.
\n    // * Positive values indicate the point is outside the shape.
\n    // Signed distance from the exterior boundary.
\n    let external_distance = sd_rounded_box(point, size, radius);
\n    // Signed distance from the border's internal edge (the signed distance is negative if the point
\n    // is inside the rect but not on the border).
\n    // If the border size is set to zero, this is the same as the external distance.
\n    let internal_distance = sd_inset_rounded_box(point, size, radius, border);
\n    // Signed distance from the border (the intersection of the rect with its border).
\n    // Points inside the border have negative signed distance. Any point outside the border, whether
\n    // outside the outside edge, or inside the inner edge have positive signed distance.
\n    let border_distance = max(external_distance, -internal_distance);
\n    // check if this node should apply color for the nearest border
\n    let nearest_border = select(0.0, 1.0, nearest_border_active(point, size, border, flags));
\n#ifdef ANTI_ALIAS
\n    // At external edges with no border, `border_distance` is equal to zero.
\n    // This select statement ensures we only perform anti-aliasing where a non-zero width border
\n    // is present, otherwise an outline about the external boundary would be drawn even without
\n    // a border.
\n    let t = select(1.0 - step(0.0, border_distance), antialias(border_distance), external_distance < internal_distance);
\n#else
\n    let t = 1.0 - step(0.0, border_distance);
\n#endif
\n    // Blend mode ALPHA_BLENDING is used for UI elements, so we don't premultiply alpha here.
\n    return vec4(color.rgb, saturate(color.a * t * nearest_border));
\nfn draw_uinode_background(
\n    color: vec4<f32>,
\n    point: vec2<f32>,
\n    size: vec2<f32>,
\n    radius: vec4<f32>,
\n    border: vec4<f32>,
\n) -> vec4<f32> {
\n    // When drawing the background only draw the internal area and not the border.
\n    let internal_distance = sd_inset_rounded_box(point, size, radius, border);
\n#ifdef ANTI_ALIAS
\n    let t = antialias(internal_distance);
\n#else
\n    let t = 1.0 - step(0.0, internal_distance);
\n#endif
\n    return vec4(color.rgb, saturate(color.a * t));
\n@fragment
\nfn fragment(in: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
\n    let texture_color = textureSample(sprite_texture, sprite_sampler, in.uv);
\n    // ── changed from upstream ──
\n    // Upstream multiplies in linear; here each factor goes back to its byte and the multiply runs
\n    // there, as the reference's fixed-function pipeline does.
\n    let textured = enabled(in.flags, TEXTURED);
\n    let tint = linear_to_srgb(in.color.rgb);
\n    let texel = linear_to_srgb(texture_color.rgb);
\n    let color = vec4<f32>(
\n        select(tint, tint * texel, textured),
\n        select(in.color.a, in.color.a * texture_color.a, textured),
\n    // ── end of the change ──
\n    if enabled(in.flags, BORDER_ANY) {
\n        return draw_uinode_border(color, in.point, in.size, in.radius, in.border, in.flags);
\n    } else {
\n        return draw_uinode_background(color, in.point, in.size, in.radius, in.border);

\n// Linear to sRGB (IEC 61966-2-1), the exact inverse of the sampler's decode.
\nfn linear_to_srgb(c: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
\n    let higher = 1.055 * pow(max(c, vec3<f32>(0.0)), vec3<f32>(1.0 / 2.4)) - 0.055;
\n    let lower = c * 12.92;
\n    return select(higher, lower, c <= vec3<f32>(0.0031308));
\nstruct UiVertexOutput {
\n    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
\n    @location(1) color: vec4<f32>,
\n    // Defines the dividing line that are used to split the texture atlas rect into corner, side and center slices
\n    // The distances are normalized and from the top left corner of the texture atlas rect
\n    // x = distance of the left vertical dividing line
\n    // y = distance of the top horizontal dividing line
\n    // z = distance of the right vertical dividing line
\n    // w = distance of the bottom horizontal dividing line
\n    @location(2) @interpolate(flat) texture_slices: vec4<f32>,
\n    // Defines the dividing line that are used to split the render target into corner, side and center slices
\n    // The distances are normalized and from the top left corner of the render target
\n    // x = distance of left vertical dividing line
\n    // y = distance of top horizontal dividing line
\n    // z = distance of right vertical dividing line
\n    // w = distance of bottom horizontal dividing line
\n    @location(3) @interpolate(flat) target_slices: vec4<f32>,
\n    // The number of times the side or center texture slices should be repeated when mapping them to the border slices
\n    // x = number of times to repeat along the horizontal axis for the side textures
\n    // y = number of times to repeat along the vertical axis for the side textures
\n    // z = number of times to repeat along the horizontal axis for the center texture
\n    // w = number of times to repeat along the vertical axis for the center texture
\n    @location(4) @interpolate(flat) repeat: vec4<f32>,
\n    // normalized texture atlas rect coordinates
\n    // x, y = top, left corner of the atlas rect
\n    // z, w = bottom, right corner of the atlas rect
\n    @location(5) @interpolate(flat) atlas_rect: vec4<f32>,
\n    @builtin(position) position: vec4<f32>,
\n@vertex
\nfn vertex(
\n    @location(0) vertex_position: vec3<f32>,
\n    @location(1) vertex_uv: vec2<f32>,
\n    @location(2) vertex_color: vec4<f32>,
\n    @location(3) texture_slices: vec4<f32>,

\n    var out: UiVertexOutput;

\n    out.color = vertex_color;

\n    out.target_slices = target_slices;
\n    out.repeat = repeat;
\n    out.atlas_rect = atlas_rect;
\n    return out;
\n/// maps a point along the axis of the render target to slice coordinates
\nfn map_axis_with_repeat(
\n    // normalized distance along the axis
\n    // target min dividing point
\n    // target max dividing point
\n    // slice min dividing point
\n    // slice max dividing point
\n    // number of times to repeat the slice for sides and the center
\n        // inside one of the two left (horizontal axis) or top (vertical axis) corners
\n        return (p / il) * tl;
\n    } else if ih < p {
\n        // inside one of the two (horizontal axis) or top (vertical axis) corners
\n        return th + ((p - ih) / (1 - ih)) * (1 - th);
\n    } else {
\n        // not inside a corner, repeat the texture
\n        return tl + fract((r * (p - il)) / (ih - il)) * (th - tl);
\nfn map_uvs_to_slice(
\n    uv: vec2<f32>,
\n    target_slices: vec4<f32>,
\n    texture_slices: vec4<f32>,
\n    repeat: vec4<f32>,
\n) -> vec2<f32> {
\n    var r: vec2<f32>;
\n    if target_slices.x <= uv.x && uv.x <= target_slices.z && target_slices.y <= uv.y && uv.y <= target_slices.w {
\n        // use the center repeat values if the uv coords are inside the center slice of the target
\n        r = repeat.zw;
\n    } else {
\n        // use the side repeat values if the uv coords are outside the center slice
\n        r = repeat.xy;
\n    // map horizontal axis
\n    let x = map_axis_with_repeat(uv.x, target_slices.x, target_slices.z, texture_slices.x, texture_slices.z, r.x);
\n    // map vertical axis
\n    let y = map_axis_with_repeat(uv.y, target_slices.y, target_slices.w, texture_slices.y, texture_slices.w, r.y);
\n    return vec2(x, y);
\n@fragment

\n    let uv = map_uvs_to_slice(in.uv, in.target_slices, in.texture_slices, in.repeat);
\n    // map the slice coords to texture coords
\n    let atlas_uv = in.atlas_rect.xy + uv * (in.atlas_rect.zw - in.atlas_rect.xy);

\n    // reference's gamma-space `SetBackdropColor` tint.
\n    let texel = textureSample(sprite_texture, sprite_sampler, atlas_uv);

\n        linear_to_srgb(in.color.rgb) * linear_to_srgb(texel.rgb),
\n        in.color.a * texel.a,
